mechanics.title: Rules
mechanics.description: Settings managed with /carpet, e.g. movableBlockEntities (pistons push chests) and hopperCounters. See the Carpet wiki for the full list.

mechanics.title: Tick control
mechanics.description: /tick warp runs the game as fast as the computer allows for testing farms.

mechanics.title: Scarpet
mechanics.description: In-game scripting language with built-in apps.

getting_started: Use /carpet to view or change rules. Needs operator permission.
editor_notes: No pack carpet config found in config overrides; check client/overrides for whether any rules are enabled. /player and /script are from general knowledge of Carpet, not facts.
name: Carpet
summary: Technical tooling mod (Fabric Carpet) that provides many toggleable rules and commands for technical play: tick control, loggers, hopper counters, fake players and the Scarpet scripting language. Most rules are off by default.
